answer: PoA trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph, where each verified edge transfers limited probability mass. A Sybil cluster’s influence must enter through its external boundary; when that cut has low conductance, conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds limit escape-adjusted reachability, capping the cluster’s aggregate voting weight despite internal collusion. Thus labels such as thread, willow, and trellis cannot substitute for attestations from honest regions.
